name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym
title: Knight of the Silver Dragon
summary: Vladimir's second and oldest friend: a big, courteous dead knight in dented plate who keeps a list of his brothers' names on his wall because he is forgetting them. The Tarokka can name him as the party's ally.

guest_build.note: His own stat block (a revenant knight in plate); joins if the Tarokka names him, or stays for one last ride when the beacon is lit.
